headline: Argentina Fuel Prices Outpace Regional Average in Dollar Terms
summary: Between February and September, gasoline prices in Argentina increased by 16% in dollar terms, surpassing the regional Latin American average of 9% as YPF gained local market share.
why: Domestic fuel pricing trends reflect national macroeconomic policies, inflation dynamics, and the commercial performance of major state-influenced energy companies in emerging markets.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: Higher domestic fuel prices and increased market share directly support the company's local revenue generation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
